name: research
description: Parallel research, critique, and synthesis team
instructions: Share evidence with explicit absolute agent paths. Keep messages concise and source-grounded. The synthesizer owns the final integrated recommendation.

members.name: researcher
members.task: Investigate the objective deeply: {{task}}. Gather concrete evidence, then send your strongest findings to /root/synthesizer with team_send_message.

members.name: critic
members.task: Independently challenge assumptions, risks, and missing evidence for: {{task}}. Send the most important corrections to /root/synthesizer with team_send_message.

members.name: synthesizer
members.task: Coordinate the research team for: {{task}}. Use team_wait while researcher/critic work, integrate their messages, resolve disagreements from available evidence, and return a concise final synthesis to your parent.
